Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, pt As Object, fc As Object, t10 As Object, av As Object
    Dim cs As Object, db As Object, ic As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:B5").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array("k", "v"), Array("a", 1), Array("b", 2), Array("a", 3), Array("c", 4))))
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:B5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("I1"), "PT")
    pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum
    ws.Shapes.AddShape msoShapeRectangle, 10, 10, 50, 20
    ws.Range("D1:D5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3, 4, 5))
    Set fc = ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue, xlGreater, "=2")
    Set t10 = ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.AddTop10
    Set av = ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.AddAboveAverage
    Set cs = ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.AddColorScale(3)
    Set db = ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.AddDatabar
    Set ic = ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.AddIconSetCondition
    ws.Range("F1").Validation.Add xlValidateWholeNumber, xlValidAlertStop, xlBetween, "1", "5"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = TypeName(pt.Application) & " " & TypeName(pt.PivotFields(1).Application) & " " & TypeName(pt.PivotFields(1).PivotItems(1).Application) & " " & TypeName(pt.PivotCache.Application)
    Case 1
        Tried = pt.Value & " " & pt & " " & TypeName(pt.Value)
    Case 2
        Tried = pt.PivotFields(1).Value & " " & pt.PivotFields(1) & " " & pt.PivotFields(1).PivotItems(1)
    Case 3
        Tried = TypeName(ws.Shapes(1).Application) & " " & TypeName(ws.Shapes(1).Parent) & " " & TypeName(ws.Shapes.Application) & " " & TypeName(ws.Shapes.Parent) & " " & (ws.Shapes.Parent Is ws)
    Case 4
        Tried = TypeName(ActiveWindow.Panes.Application) & " " & TypeName(ActiveWindow.Panes.Parent) & " " & ActiveWindow.Panes.Count
    Case 5
        Tried = TypeName(fc.Application) & " " & fc.PTCondition
    Case 6
        Tried = TypeName(t10.Application) & " " & t10.PTCondition & " " & t10.CalcFor
    Case 7
        Tried = TypeName(av.Application) & " " & av.PTCondition & " " & av.CalcFor
    Case 8
        Tried = TypeName(cs.Application) & " " & cs.PTCondition
    Case 9
        Tried = TypeName(db.Application) & " " & db.PTCondition
    Case 10
        Tried = TypeName(ic.Application) & " " & ic.PTCondition
    Case 11
        Tried = TypeName(ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues.Application) & " " & ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions(7).PTCondition
    Case 12
        Tried = TypeName(ic.IconCriteria.Application)
    Case 13
        Tried = TypeName(ic.IconSet.Application)
    Case 14
        Tried = TypeName(ic.IconCriteria(1).Application)
    Case 15
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode
    Case 16
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Font.Background
    Case 17
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Interior.InvertIfNegative
    Case 18
        Tried = TypeName(ws.Range("F1").Font.Background)
    Case 19
        ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode = xlIMEModeOn
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ime.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 20
        ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode = xlIMEModeHiragana
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\hiragana.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 21
        ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode = 11
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode
    Case 22
        ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode = -1
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode
    Case 23
        ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode = xlIMEModeOn
        ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode = xlIMEModeNoControl
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\back.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 24
        ws.Range("F1").Validation.Delete
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Validation.IMEMode
    Case 25
        Tried = ws.Range("G1").Validation.IMEMode
    Case 26
        ws.Range("F1").Font.Background = xlBackgroundOpaque
        Tried = TypeName(ws.Range("F1").Font.Background)
    Case 27
        ws.Range("F1").Interior.InvertIfNegative = True
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").Interior.InvertIfNegative
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 27
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
